predictions.predicted:
db.AIRPORTS.aggregate([
    { $lookup: { from: "FLIGHTS", localField: "_id", foreignField: "departureAirportId", as: "flights" } },
    { $unwind: "$flights" },
    { $group: { _id: "$iataCode", count: { $sum: 1 } } },
    { $sort: { count: -1 } },
    { $limit: 1 },
    { $project: { iataCode: 1, country: "$country" } },
    { $lookup: { from: "AIRPORTS", localField: "iataCode", foreignField: "_id", as: "airport" } },
    { $unwind: "$airport" },
    { $match: { airlineId: { $exists: false } } },
    { $project: { iataCode: 1, country: 1 } }
]);
